body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended The OpenRC naming helper currently depends on `init_system()` instead of the effective backend, which can generate mismatched OpenRC service names under forced/fallback backends and break service management. *Once you've addressed the issues Copilot identified, you can request another Copilot review.*
Pull request overview This PR adds Alpine Linux (OpenRC) support by introducing a service-manager abstraction that lets sb-manager manage sing-box/cloudflared consistently across systemd and OpenRC, plus Alpine-specific install/scheduling/test coverage. **Changes:** - Add a systemd/OpenRC service abstraction (`lib/service.sh`) and integrate it into install, lifecycle reconcile, doctor/repair, tunnel management, and uninstall flows. - Add Alpine/OpenRC runtime generation: OpenRC `supervise-daemon` services and `dcron` `/etc/periodic` jobs for core update, ACME renew, and Quick Tunnel refresh. - Extend CI and tests with OpenRC lifecycle coverage and an Alpine 3.21–3.24 musl smoke matrix.
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | VERSION | Bump project version to `0.1.0-alpha.3`. | | setup.sh | Add apk dependency path; generate systemd/OpenRC runtime + periodic jobs; unify service operations via abstraction. | | sb | Source new service abstraction library. | | README.md | Document OpenRC + Alpine support, requirements, install steps, and log locations. | | CHANGELOG.md | Document `0.1.0-alpha.3` features and tests. | | docs/ARCHITECTURE.md | Document dual service backends and OpenRC operational model. | | lib/common.sh | Add OpenRC/periodic/log defaults; replace legacy systemd-only helpers; add BusyBox/musl helpers. | | lib/service.sh | New service-manager abstraction (systemd/OpenRC) + OpenRC script generator + cap helper. | | lib/state.sh | Switch service reconcile logic from systemd-only to abstraction; use portable group lookup. | | lib/tunnel.sh | Add OpenRC support for cloudflared service + periodic refresh; abstract logs/extract-domain per backend. | | lib/doctor.sh | Make doctor/repair backend-aware; add OpenRC-specific checks (capability, time sync heuristics, logs). | | lib/core.sh | Apply bind capability on OpenRC when downloading/switching cores; use new skip-init flag. | | lib/cert.sh | Restart service via abstraction after cert updates. | | lib/uninstall.sh | Uninstall both systemd/OpenRC artifacts; delete service account safely on purge; remove logs on purge. | | lib/ui.sh | Show init backend label; use skip-init flag instead of skip-systemd. | | tests/service-lifecycle.sh | Update env flags; source service abstraction. | | tests/run.sh | Update env flags; source service abstraction. | | tests/install-smoke.sh | Update env flags; version assertion; source service abstraction. | | tests/doctor-smoke.sh | Update env flags; source service abstraction. | | tests/core-download-smoke.sh | Update env flags; source service abstraction. | | tests/acme-install-smoke.sh | Update env flags; source service abstraction. | | tests/openrc-lifecycle.sh | New isolated OpenRC lifecycle regression test. | | tests/alpine-smoke.sh | New Alpine musl smoke test validating real assets + OpenRC output + uninstall. | | .github/workflows/ci.yml | Add libcap dependency, OpenRC lifecycle step, and Alpine 3.21–3.24 smoke matrix. |
